dedupe_keys.name: rail ifc quality gate r3 r7 open source reference implementation v1 0 4

description: Juan García and colleagues at Alicante University publish a Python quality-checking pipeline for rail and depot IFC deliverables. The tool evaluates georeferencing, TrueNorth and anchor consistency, proxy use and staged property-set completeness, then produces CSV evidence and a release-or-hold outcome. Configuration uses YAML profiles and thresholds; the README describes a command-line interface and optional IfcOpenShell parsing. Zenodo archives version 1.0.4 in July 2026 under CC BY 4.0, while the current GitHub repository states MIT. These differing source licences should be checked for the version reused. The tool can prepare geometrically and semantically consistent assets for digital-twin simulations. Real operational IFC files are excluded; synthetic benchmarks and derived outputs are separate. Generalisation across owner requirements remains uncertain. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the pipeline. Source files were not downloaded or executed.
